method: Disconfirm: recorded visitor-task falsifiers before interacting with the live UI. Revised the implementation after failures, then exercised rendered Chromium pages.
initial_claim: A visitor can identify available information, open a useful preview and return without losing context.

before_evidence.title: Photo source — Mobilisation pour le Progrès d’Haïti (MPH)

before_evidence.breadcrumb: Hover, use your keyboard or tap a point on the web.
Hover, use your keyboard or tap a point on the web.

corrections: A native mobile dialog keeps source details and actions in view, with focus containment and restoration.
Disabled empty topics and explicit registry-only coverage help set expectations.
Source titles distinguish nodes; source format and excerpt limits remain explicit.
Candidate context and registration facts appear inside previews; preliminary status remains visible above the web.
Back, sharing and language changes preserve the candidate, selected source and topic.
Seventeen source previews now summarize credited source material rather than only photo provenance.

edge_cases.fixture: Nine explicitly synthetic sources in a client-intercepted browser document; no public data changed.

edge_cases.note: Player request intercepted by a stub. Actual YouTube streaming was not tested or claimed.

copy_review.method: Independent AI reviewer recorded an HT-only reading before opening English.
copy_review.applied_correction: Preserved En Avant pour Haïti as the proper party name.
copy_review.optional_refinements: Aligned the English proposal label with Pwopozisyon and made the archival context explicit.

limits: Browser automation is not a human usability study or physical-device certification.
The 8990 registrations share templates; 38 selected profiles were individually exercised, not 8990 browser sessions.
Player request and lifecycle checks use an intercepted iframe request; real YouTube streaming was not asserted.
